source_limitations: No official source located in this study directly documents the exact S3 archive cutover timestamp within 2025-07-27T08.
The public node repository documents output behavior but does not expose the closed node serializer/uploader implementation needed to prove exact event-by-event cutover semantics.

sources.fact: Before the archive boundary date, the official node documentation stated that --write-fills streams API-format fills to node_fills/hourly/{date}/{hour}.

Before the archive boundary date, the official node documentation stated that --batch-by-block writes the same auxiliary streams one block per line with local_time, block_time, block_number and events.

Official historical-data documentation identifies node_fills_by_block as fills streamed via --write-fills --batch-by-block and describes node_fills as older data in a different format that matches the API fill format.
Official documentation states that --batch-by-block waits until the end of a block to write data.
